title: Normalized ordinary reduced transport equation
statement: For source and target transports from the two finite-reduced functors to the canonical finite quotient model, the reduced ordinary comparison followed by the target transport equals the source transport.

proof.text: Evaluate the three maps on the quotient unit, where all insertion maps send 1 tensor m to the same class, then use the scalar-extension adjunction to extend this equality to every object and cancel the coefficient identifications.

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryReducedPull_transport_eq (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (s : (res (coefficientMap J A I) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ (change (projection J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))))) (t : (pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ res (coefficientMap J' A I) ⋙ change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ (change (projection J A I n) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))))) : Functor.whiskerRight (ordinaryPullComparison F A I) (change (quotient J' A I n)) ≫ t.hom = s.hom
